The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the density range of interest, the transport coefficients are not strongly dependent on the density.
in the inner core of neutron stars, where beta-stable matter is reached, the transport coefficients are much larger than those obtained in the standard approximation of a free Fermi gas.
the in-medium NN cross section is a crucial ingredient for a quantitative study of neutron star dynamics and cooling, as the cross section determines the strength of the transport coefficients.
